name: The music that followed
source:
You play as a traveling musician who enters a town in the midst of celebration. However, are things really just as they seem or is something more sinister lurking underneath that cheery exterior? 

A concept demo based on the historical tale of the Pied Piper of Hamelin (which contrary to popular belief, did not actually include any rats!)

[From [url=https://mishatventures.itch.io/the-music-that-followed]Itch.io[/url]]
